Establish an independent starting point

When a marriage ends, deciding what happens to the family home can be one of the most difficult financial questions. One person may want to stay, while the other prefers to sell. Either way, a credible, independent opinion of market value can give both sides a clearer starting point for discussing the property.

How a divorce appraisal differs

A divorce appraisal is different from an online price estimate or a real estate agent’s suggested list price. A residential appraiser analyzes relevant comparable sales, the home’s features and condition, and local market trends to develop a supported value opinion for a specified effective date. Depending on the legal process, the parties or their attorneys may need a current or retrospective valuation.
